title: Scripture and Discernment
definition: Scripture and Discernment means God’s Word trains believers to recognize truth, reject error, and walk wisely before the Lord.
summary: Scripture and Discernment means God’s Word trains believers to recognize truth, reject error, and walk wisely before the Lord.
christFocus: Jesus is the truth, and Scripture equips His people to follow His voice rather than the voices of deception, fear, confusion, or false teaching.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Discernment is not suspicion toward everything; it is Spirit-enabled wisdom shaped by Scripture. The believer learns to test teaching, motives, desires, cultural messages, and spiritual claims by God’s Word.

Scripture gives discernment by revealing truth clearly. It shows who God is, what sin is, what salvation is, how Christ saves, how believers should live, and what dangers threaten faithfulness.

Christ’s sheep need discernment because many voices compete for the heart. Scripture teaches believers to know the Shepherd’s voice and to avoid teaching that leads away from Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People who have been manipulated spiritually may either trust too easily or trust no one at all. Scripture-shaped discernment provides a better way: neither gullible nor cynical, but grounded in truth.

This doctrine also helps recovery and discipleship because not every desire, opportunity, or influence leads to life. God’s Word trains believers to recognize what draws them toward Christ and what pulls them away.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Test what you hear, feel, desire, and believe by Scripture. Pray for wisdom, seek mature counsel, examine fruit, and follow the voice of Christ over every voice that contradicts His Word.
